prompts.long: Edit the supplied approved mobile loading-screen artwork for game 泡泡小队. Preserve the exact bright orange/golden yellow and cobalt palette, tactile fluffy blue bear with cream double muzzle blowing bubbles, small happy green frog in turquoise pot, felt cloud blue pot, green leaves, translucent soap bubbles and the existing Chinese title “泡泡小队”. This is the APPROVED style: do not redesign the mascot, font, colors, artwork or add new objects. Remove the entire baked UI in the lower area: erase the text “加载中… 36%”, erase the whole ivory/blue progress bar with shadow, erase the small footer text “适度游戏，快乐生活”. Seamlessly continue the same warm golden blurred background into all erased areas. There must be NO TEXT other than the existing top game name, and NO progress bars or UI at the bottom. Do not add a transparent area: keep the full bleed golden background. Keep the original tall portrait aspect ratio, 9:19.5, and preserve original layout and scale; all top 80% of the approved picture must remain visually unchanged. Output one tall image only.
